text_block_list.text:
Today is a magazine interview focused on racewear.
Shinko Windy and Biko Pegasus changed into their racewear
and waited for the photoshoot to begin.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Looking forward to working with you today, Windy-senpai!
Let's take some great photos together!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You're right, this is a great chance to spread
the terror of evil! I'm gonna stand out more than Biko!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what...?! Th-then I'll just show everyone
the spirit of true justice!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Preparations for shooting are complete!
We'll start with Windy-san, please!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, sounds good! Now next,
how about giving me a cute, bright smile?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Haaah?! I don't wanna!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey, Windy-senpai?!
You can't go causing trouble for the cameraman!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmph! Smiling is strictly out of the question!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"This racing attire is a design that pursues true villainy!
With fangs and fluff, it's totally wicked and cool!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
A sweet smile doesn't suit this outfit at all!
It's the total opposite of what my racewear is supposed to be!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hmm... In that case, what kind of vibe do you want?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, it's gotta be cool!
Something that really conveys the terror of evil!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"I can't leave things to someone who says stuff like 'smile cutely~'.
Listen up, you guys! Follow Windy-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Windy-chan will decide everything!
Evil is free! Wahaha!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you serious, Windy-senpai...!?
I wonder if the shoot's gonna go okay...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh... This gloomy under-the-bridge vibe!
It feels super villainous, I say!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Come on, take the picture already!
Capture Windy-chan's terrifying visage!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, nice!
With the shadow of the bridge cast over it, it looks super powerful!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Next is like this!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, look at that wild look!
It looks so tough and cool! Truly villainous!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, that feels very cool
and just like Windy-senpai...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wahaha! That's that for the solo shots!
All right, Biko! Next, we're shooting evil versus justice!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Biko Pegasus!
I'm gonna beat you black and blue!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Huh... But...

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Evil vs. Justice, huh! Nice, sounds fun!
Biko, could you join in?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes! In that case—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Prepare yourself, Windy-senpai!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I think I'm getting into the groove now...!
Windy-senpai! How about this?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
This is my signature—
hero poooose--!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Mmh, not bad at all...!
I'm not gonna lose to you--!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Nishishi! The filming's going great!
And it's aallll thanks to Windy-chan!
choice_data_list: This is gonna turn into a great photo!
This looks like it'll be a great photo!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Fufun! You get it!
If you've got pose ideas, I might just hear you out!
choice_data_list: Strike any pose you like just as you are!
Still, I really want to see you go the cute route too...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Gwahaha, that really is the best way, huh!
Let us take tons of photos of me as the Demon King just like this!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
A super cool photo that'll make
everrryone who sees it totally freak out!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh-heh! Windy-chan in her race outfit looks super villainous~!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: "This photo is the absolute best! I'm gonna show it off to everyone at the academy~!"
Shinko Windy looks satisfied seeing her photo in the magazine. Sticking to her villainous pride seems to have paid off.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!? Are you saying that too!?
There's no way true evil takes cute pictures!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Now, now... Since we're already here, why don't you try it with me? A cute pose.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmph! No way, not a chance. If you wanna do it, go do it all by yourself!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ugahh!? No way, that's impossiblee!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"How come Biko's cute pose gets
a bigger photo than Windy-chan's...
Gggrrr...!"

Losing to Biko Pegasus in terms of article size seemed to really frustrate Shinko Windy.
Fired up with competitive spirit, she vowed not to lose next time.
